response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile software engineer with strong web, full-stack, and some systems-level background, but his profile does not match this role's core requirement of deep, recent C++ expertise for industrial automation. His only professional C++ experience was a brief stint at National Instruments over a decade ago; his career since has centered on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. There is no evidence of MQTT/IoT protocol work, IEC 62443 or SDL security practices, or industrial automation domain experience.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across web, backend, and embedded contexts
Proven high-performance, low-latency systems work (async I/O, caching, fibers) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ experience (roughly 6 months, ending 2015)
No industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 exposure required by the role
No IoT/MQTT, industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC UA), or automation-industry background

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and performance-systems background
